body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Black and Decker unveiled the 'iShred Vertical Shredder' at 2011 CES Unveiled.

Patented, revolutionary design limits access to any blades providing added security. The unique fluted bin allows for easy, clean emptying and added stability. The sleek design fits in any house or office setting.
-Fully enclosed shredder head with no access to exposed blades
-Sliding safety shield covering the shredder entry
-100% jam-free technology, no more paper jams
